take.bookTitle: The making of the LEGO Odyssey

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Wool. The camera is inside the ram.

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: The ram was the hottest thing in the scene. I went where the heat was.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Then test every camera against the set before you roll. Is the lens inside something? Is every face in the frame, and seen?

segments.speaker: cinematographer
segments.caption: Out of the wool. Off his shoulder. Both of them in the frame.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Night. Four processors, and no graphics card. Every frame drawn in software, one at a time: almost four seconds a frame.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Twelve for every second of film. Seven hundred and twenty for a minute.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.caption: Nothing is lost. Every frame is kept as it is drawn, so the render goes on from where it stopped.
